newsitem.title: SPAIN: Santander ups San Paolo stake-paper.
newsitem.headline: Santander ups San Paolo stake-paper.

text.p: Spanish Banco Santander raised its stake in Istituto Bancario San Paolo di Torino by around three percent to six percent, the financial daily Expansion wrote on Tuesday.
No one was immediately available at Santander to confirm.

Mid-April, a statement from Compagnia, which indirectly controls San Paolo, said Santander, with other Italian firms would become core shareholders in the Turin's bank with a stake of five percent each.
The paper adds the new stake bought by Santander affects 24,479,786 shares of San Paolo for around 20 billion pesetas.
Santander had already a stake of more than a three percent in San Paolo, and an option expiring at the end of June to buy another three percent.
